title: Skip verification producer-observation reads during note search
outcome: Canonical note search decodes only the public note text and refs it matches, without loading verification producer facts.
acceptance: The note-search read of verification evidence loads its producer ExecutionObservation only for the canonical projection validation, not again for displayed typed facts, while ordinary show readers retain their typed verification facts.
Tests cover verification summary/ref search without producer-fact loading and preserve eligible scope, matching locators, deduplication and snapshot semantics.

completion.summary: Removed the redundant verification display-facts producer read from note search while retaining canonical producer validation and ordinary show facts.
